newsitem.title: USA: NeoStar Retail sale gets approval.
newsitem.headline: NeoStar Retail sale gets approval.

text.p: NeoStar Retail Group Inc, the parent of Babbage's and Software Etc, said Software Acquisition Co LLC received U.S. Bankruptcy Court approval to buy all of the company's assets for $58.5 million.
The price is for 447 of NeoStar's software stores and all of its inventory, NeoStar said.
NeoStar said Software Acquisition was formed by Leonard Riggio, a NeoStar Director who is the principal stockholder of Barnes & Noble Inc.
As a result of the sale, approximately 200 NeoStar stores will be closed, the company said.
NeoStar filed Chapter 11 in September and decided to auction the assets due to the absence of viable financing alternatives, the company said.
